note: Static upload (Vercel): there is no game server on this origin. /api/health, /api/rooms and /api/characters are answered from these files, and the match itself is run by the page -- public/engine/*.py under Pyodide, driven by public/js/local.js. Multiplayer works here too: whoever creates a room runs that match in their own browser and the players reach each other through a public MQTT relay (public/js/relay.js), so any number of rooms can run at once.
